note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated outbound customs records with destination, HS code and B/L number exist (e.g. 2026-02-18, Johannesburg ZA, HS 84145930, B/L 9782524), plus recurring named overseas buyers in UAE and UK. IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: the declared HS set (820210 hand saws; 846721/846722/846729 hand-held electric tools) does not match the observed trade. Actual observed codes are 84145930 (fans/blowers), 84249000 and 84244900 (sprayer parts and agricultural sprayers), 84322990 (agricultural power weeder bodies) — i.e. the company is an electric-motor/blower and agricultural-sprayer maker, not a hand-tool maker. Per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection: company stays in the base, HS code should be corrected to the factual range (8414/8424/8432), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Trade flow is two-way: it also imports sprayer parts and weeder bodies from Chinese suppliers (Ningbo, Chongqing, Taizhou, Jinhua), so it is a manufacturer_trader rather than a pure manufacturer.
